create_PopArt_layer: create a PopArt layer with input and output shapes for PPO value head normalization
build_PopArt_forward: build a forward pass through a PopArt linear layer with automatic numpy to tensor conversion
test_PopArt_update: test the PopArt update method to track running mean and variance with exponential moving average
refactor_PopArt_normalize: refactor the PopArt normalize method to standardize input vectors using debiased mean and variance
review_PopArt_denormalize: review the PopArt denormalize method to convert normalized values back to original scale as numpy array
